issue.title: Parenthesized %auto(...) silently drops named args and fails open to full bare-%auto automation
issue.description:
Parenthesized `%auto(...)` / `%a(...)` silently drops every named argument and extra
positional, so a prompt that *looks* like it restricts automation is extracted as bare
`%auto`, which is full automation: tale plans approved and archived, epic plans approved
and launched, and questions auto-answered with the first option.

Root cause: the generic directive collector (`src/sase/macro/_directive_collect.py`)
parses named args, but `%auto` has no paren-specific handler. `resolve_auto_mode` /
`resolve_auto_argument` (`src/sase/macro/_directive_values.py`) only ever see the first
positional, or nothing. Rust editor metadata advertises only colon/bare/plus forms for
`auto`, so these forms are undocumented, yet they are accepted and fail open instead of
being rejected.

Observed on master 142636c528 with the installed sase interpreter and the workspace `src`
first on `sys.path`, calling `sase.macro.directives.extract_prompt_directives`:

    '%auto(plan=ask, questions=ask)' -> auto_enabled=True mode='plan' argument=None
    '%a(epic=ask)'                   -> auto_enabled=True mode='plan' argument=None
    '%auto(sudo=approve)'            -> auto_enabled=True mode='plan' argument=None
    '%auto(plan, epic)'              -> auto_enabled=True mode='plan' argument='plan'
    '%auto:off'                      -> auto_enabled=True mode='off'  argument='off'

Expected: extraction raises a DirectiveError for any named argument, any extra
positional, or a mixed `%auto:x(...)` form on `%auto`/`%a`, until such forms have real
semantics. The Python extractor, the Rust typed launch extractor, editor directive
metadata, and the macro LSP should agree. Add a regression test in
`tests/test_directives_flags.py`.

Related, but separable (decide in the same change or leave to the %auto redesign):
`%auto:off` enables automation with an opaque `off` argument. Plan gates then fail
mid-run with `invalid_auto_argument`, while question gates still auto-answer, because
`user_question_gate_spec` only receives a bool. Failing unknown colon values at launch
would also fix this, but it changes the documented "opaque argument reaches the
adapter" contract in `docs/macros.md`.

Context: consolidated %auto research,
research:202610/auto_directive_autonomy_policy/auto_directive_autonomy_policy__final.md
(defects D1/D2).

task_type_fields.impact: Any user or generated prompt that tries to narrow %auto with keyword syntax silently gets maximal gate automation: tale plans approved and archived, epic plans approved and launched (clan fan-out), questions auto-answered.
task_type_fields.repro: python: extract_prompt_directives('%auto(plan=ask, questions=ask)\nx') returns auto_enabled=True, auto_mode='plan', auto_argument=None (same for '%a(epic=ask)')

issue.creation_reason: Found while consolidating %auto redesign research: a prompt written to restrict automation, such as %auto(epic=ask), grants full automation instead, so it should fail at launch rather than fail open.
